first_failed_transition: An accepted full SetSurroundingText leaves armed_revision at the earlier baseline. A subsequent valid delayed-prefix observation or identical full reply is rejected as a second receipt before the existing bounded exact revalidation can run.
decision: Advance the existing receipt baseline to every accepted actual exact observation. Preserve the first causally authenticated owned-append full handoff. When the immediately previous observation already exactly bounds the current pending token, preservation of confirmed authority requires equality of the full previous and current text/cursor/anchor, consecutive observation revisions and all current owner/token/epoch guards. Missing prior observation or changed external context cannot refresh authority. The existing managed strict-prefix echo remains inert and admits only the immediately following full exact receipt; no generic delayed-prefix promotion. Move the previous actual snapshot temporarily through the sole callback consumer, without persistent new fields or a second owner. A manual handoff still consumes the pending receipt once. One phase flag in the existing pending receipt distinguishes confirmation carried through an authenticated owned append from an already accepted full client observation. The append producer invalidates its old client snapshot, so absence alone cannot distinguish the first new receipt from a missing already confirmed snapshot. Only that producer sets the flag; accepting the actual full receipt clears it. Generic Reset, erasure and fresh receipt constructors never set it. No persistent snapshot clone or parallel owner is added. Replan after the second review: scope prefix echoes to the end of the whole actual snapshot on the original full, partial and final full observations. starts_with alone does not preserve text to the right of the caret. An echo inside text is deliberately refused; supporting that would require proving equality of both external parts and is deferred.
supersedes: Blanket identical-repeat refusal only in residual_reset_rereceipt_failures_never_delete_gui_text, firefox_reset_suffix_frame_and_tab_refuse_unconfirmed_or_invalid_receipts, and window_interaction_reset_rereceipt_uses_existing_one_shot_token. Changed-context contradictions and one-shot consume remain proved. Published-preedit unchanged receipt and completed/consumed Replay refusals remain unchanged. The identical-second-receipt assertion after a new Reset in firefox_fresh_surrounding_after_confirmed_append_rearms_next_reset also migrates to actual bridge delegation followed by one-shot consumption refusal.
